usageNotes: Rolls back an LXC container's disk and configuration to the state captured in the named snapshot; the container must be stopped before rollback unless the snapshot itself includes RAM state. Returns a UPID task string — poll the node's task log to confirm completion before treating the rollback as done. Requires either VM.Snapshot or VM.Snapshot.Rollback privilege on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: Roll back container 112 to snapshot 'pre-upgrade' and start it automatically after

destructiveReason: All disk and configuration changes made after the snapshot was taken are permanently discarded and cannot be recovered once the rollback completes.
tips: Stop the container before rolling back if the snapshot does not include RAM state; a running container rollback may fail or corrupt state.
Use 'start': true to avoid a separate start call after rollback — useful in automated recovery scripts.
Take a safety snapshot of the current state before rolling back if there is any chance you need to preserve recent changes.
The returned UPID should be polled via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm the task succeeded before proceeding.
